description.value: Rutland Twin Arena is a City of Kelowna public recreation facility featuring two arenas primarily used for lacrosse, located in the Rutland neighbourhood of Kelowna. As part of the broader Rutland Recreation Park complex, it serves the east Kelowna community as a multi-sport venue. Touring cyclists passing through the area may find it a useful stop as a publicly-operated facility.
